subject: MAP: Acceptance Conditions & Data Retention Annex — MeridianPay
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@meridianpay.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@meridianpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft: Security gates & data retention annex for MeridianPay

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first pass MAP template tailored for MeridianPay (attachment: redwood-map-template-meridianpay-v1.xlsx). I focused the security/compliance section on the items we discussed: SOC 2 evidence intake, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, DPA redline, and a proposed data retention annex.

High-level proposal (feedback requested):
- Acceptance gate A (onboarding): SOC 2 Type II sign/off or equivalent evidence intake completed — target 3 weeks from evidence intake start.
- Acceptance gate B (go-live): DPA executed with retention annex (see proposed retention buckets below).
- Evidence owners: Meridian security/engineering to own SOC 2 artifacts; Meridian legal to own DPA redline; Redwood to provide audit logs and traceability artifacts.

Proposed data retention buckets for MeridianPay evaluation run (we can adjust):
- Request logs / traces: 90 days (hot), 1 year (cold) — with optional 3 year archive on request
- Transaction metadata used in ML features: up to 3 years (subject to redaction)
- Exported embeddings / model cache: 30 days by default (longer if customer chooses dedicated/private deployment)

Ask: please confirm who at MeridianPay will be the evidence owners for SOC 2 artifacts and who will handle the DPA redline. Also, any firm procurement cutoff dates we should be aware of?

I'll schedule an intake workshop next week if that works — Marcus and Kimberly will be available for the evidence walkthrough.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-map-template-meridianpay-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@meridianpay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@meridianpay.com>, Priya Subramaniam <psubramaniam@meridianpay.com>, Procurement <procure@meridianpay.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Security gates & data retention annex for MeridianPay

Sofia —

Thanks for the draft and for pulling the buckets together. Quick notes from our side:
1) Evidence owners: Tom (engineering lead) will own SOC 2 artifacts intake; Priya (legal) will drive the DPA redline. Procurement (procure@meridianpay.com) flagged May 10 as our preferred contract sign target — procurement needs the final DPA redline by May 3 to make that work.
2) SOC 2 scope: we intend to require SOC 2 Type II for production (so that should be the acceptance condition). If Redwood can accept equivalent third-party attestations in the short term for the evaluation sandbox, call that out.
3) EU residency: MeridianPay will require EU data residency for EU customer data. Can Redwood support region-limited hosting for the evaluation or will that require a Private deployment?

I've attached our initial evidence inventory to help accelerate intake.

Elena
Head of Security Operations
MeridianPay

Attachment: MeridianPay-evidence-inventory.csv (csv)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@meridianpay.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@meridianpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Security gates & data retention annex for MeridianPay

Elena —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the inventory. Responses inline below.

- SOC 2: Understood — SOC 2 Type II will be required for production. For the evaluation sandbox we can accept recent SOC 2 Type I or a Trust Center report plus targeted artifacts (user access lists, incident response runbook, vendor management) while you complete Type II. We'll mark the sandbox acceptance as "conditional" and set a hard production acceptance to Type II.

- DPA deadline: May 3 for redline is noted. We'll prioritize legal to return a DPA with the proposed retention appendix by Apr 30 to allow time for your procurement review.

- EU residency: Redwood hosted API supports region-limited deployment in eu-west-1 for customer data; for full private control (VPC/on-prem) we can onboard a Private deployment which would add ~4–6 weeks to the timeline. For evaluation we recommend hosted with eu-west-1 tenant isolation — we'll include that option in the MAP and call out the Private deployment as a go/no-go decision before production.

Proposed acceptance timeline (compressed):
- Week 0 (Apr 26): Evidence intake workshop (we propose 60–90m).
- Week 1 (May 3): Redwood returns DPA redline + evidence ask backlog for SOC 2 artifacts.
- Week 2 (May 10): Procurement target; conditional sandbox access granted if backlog items are agreed.
- Week 5 (Jun 7): Production readiness decision (SOC 2 Type II or equivalent in place or signed remediation plan).

Can Tom / Priya confirm owners for the items listed in tab "Security-acceptance" of the MAP template? If so we'll convert the MAP to a shared doc and add dates.

—Sofia

Sofia / Ben —

Confirmed on our side:
- Tom Huang (me) will be primary owner for SOC 2 evidence intake; I'll assign two engineers (names shared offline) to the artifacts list.
- Priya will handle DPA redline and coordinate with procurement. Procurement has May 3 as their internal DPA review cutoff; will escalate if needed.
- EU residency: we accept the eu-west-1 hosted tenant for the evaluation. If production requires Private deployment we'll flag during the production readiness decision.

We reviewed the MAP spreadsheet and signed off on the Acceptance Conditions tab — please convert the MAP to a shared Google Doc and add the week-by-week dates as Sofia proposed. We've also placed a DocuSign envelope for the DPA redline (link below) for initial review — Priya will circulate.
